issues.description: Reviewers say features they consider basic, which used to be free, now require a premium subscription.
issues.title: Basic features locked behind premium paywall

issues.description: Reviewers say the subscription costs too much and the free version is hard to use because of frequent ads.
issues.title: Subscription too expensive and free tier unusable

issues.description: Reviewers report that lyrics are sometimes not available for songs they want to view.
issues.title: Missing lyrics for some songs

issues.description: Reviewers report that lyrics do not load and they cannot go back to or start a song at a chosen point.
issues.title: Lyrics fail to load and seeking breaks

issues.description: A subscriber reports being unable to play music in offline mode despite paying for the subscription.
issues.title: Cannot play music in offline mode

issues.description: A reviewer expresses hatred toward the app in connection with a country and a religion, without describing a specific app problem.
issues.title: Hostility tied to political or religious views

issues.description: Reviewers express general hatred of the app, calling it bad, and one claims it bans conservative and Christian songs.
issues.title: General dislike and claims of banned songs

issues.description: A reviewer says the update is very bad and wants the older version of Spotify back.
issues.title: Recent update made app worse

issues.description: Reviewers in this group report the app crashing while playing music.
issues.title: App crashes during playback

issues.description: A reviewer reports that songs play only briefly then stop, and the problem persists after updating the phone.
issues.title: Songs stop playing after a few seconds

issues.description: Reviewers report that songs fail to play, rewinding does not work, and the app will not open after recent updates.
issues.title: Songs won't play or app won't open after update

issues.description: Reviewers say ads play too frequently, such as after every song or two, and interrupt their listening.
issues.title: Too many ads interrupting listening

issues.description: A reviewer reports that an ad starts suddenly at a much louder volume than the music, hurting their ears.
issues.title: Ads play at sudden loud volume
